privileged_info_for_vlm: The dataset contains 21 participants total. Participant 'sub-099' must be marked as excluded in the JSON. The 'group_summary' means must only be calculated from the other 20 participants. All numeric values in the final JSON must be rounded to exactly one decimal place.
